t: 批准日，美国：国会批准与英国的《巴黎条约》。

t: 1784年1月14日美国国会批准的"巴黎条约"由大不列颠王国国王乔治三世批准,结束了美国革命战…
te: The Treaty of Paris, ratified by the United States Congress on January 14, 1784, is ratified by King George III of the …
dz: 1784年1月14日美国国会批准的"巴黎条约"由大不列颠王国国王乔治三世批准,结束了美国革命战争. 批准的文件副本于1784年5月12日交换.
de: The Treaty of Paris, ratified by the United States Congress on January 14, 1784, is ratified by King George III of the Kingdom of Great Britain, ending the American Revolutionary War. Copies of the ratified documents are exchanged on May 12, 1784.

dz: 伊丽莎白·蒂布尔 (Elisabeth Thible) 成为第一位乘坐无系留热气球的女性。她的飞行在 45 分钟内飞行了 4 公里（2.5 英里），预计高度达到 1,500 米（4,900 英尺）。
de: Élisabeth Thible becomes the first woman to fly in an untethered hot air balloon. Her flight covers four kilometres (2.5 mi) in 45 minutes, and reaches an estimated 1,500 metres (4,900 ft) in altitude.

de: The first British mail coach service runs from Bristol to London.

de: Russian colonization of North America: Awa'uq Massacre: The Russian fur trader Grigory Shelikhov storms a Kodiak Island Alutiit refuge rock on Sitkalidak Island, killing 500+ Alutiit.
